overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's notice was posted 48 hours ahead and later revised, and the last-minute added topic was not anticipated until minutes before posting. The AG declined the hearing and due process claims as outside its review.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not properly post notice of its Nov 13, 2015 meeting, after the notice was revised within 48 hours of it.
allegations.key_passage: Although the final version of the notice was posted fewer than 48 hours before the meeting, because the added topic was not anticipated by the chair until mere minutes before it was posted, we find no violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not hold a proper hearing and committed due process violations; the AG reviews only Open Meeting Law compliance.
allegations.key_passage: thus we decline to review, and offer no opinion on, whether there was a violation of any separate public hearing law.
